mapper.select: SELECT id,buyer_id,vendor_id,status,shipping_fee_status,shipping_fee FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_orders SET shipping_fee=#{fee},shipping_fee_note=#{note},shipping_fee_status='proposed',shipping_fee_deadline=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 24 HOUR),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE t_orders SET shipping_fee=#{fee},shipping_fee_status='countered',shipping_fee_note=CONCAT('买家反提：',COALESCE(shipping_fee_note,'')),shipping_fee_deadline=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 24 HOUR),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}
